screening_reasoning: An editorial overview of a special issue on UAVs for vegetation monitoring, summarizing twenty-one papers; secondary literature, not a primary empirical benchmark.
A comprehensive review of deep learning architectures and recent advances across general domains; secondary literature with no agricultural benchmark.

Weed/crop detection and classification combines YOLOv8m bounding-box detection with SVM/ANN feature classification on weed datasets; bounding-box detection plus classification, not pixel-level segmentation.

Mask R-CNN performs instance segmentation and counting/sizing of potato and lettuce plants in UAV aerial imagery, reporting segmentation mAP based on IoU of instance masks, matching the UAV crop pixel-segmentation scope.

An adaptive autonomous UAV scouting system for rice lodging assessment uses deep neural networks (EDANet) with on-board edge computing, reporting 99.25% accuracy, satisfying UAV crop-stress segmentation with both accuracy and edge-deployment metrics.
A systematic review of deep neural networks to detect weeds from crops in real time; secondary literature, not a primary benchmark.
A review of deep learning in plant stress imaging/phenotyping; secondary literature, not a primary segment benchmark.
A mobile Android app uses a CNN to classify 38 plant leaf disease categories from captured leaf photos; whole-image disease classification without pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
A comprehensive review of remote sensing and machine learning integration in precision agriculture; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
cGAN-based data augmentation improves crop/weed classification models (AlexNet/SVM/LDA); it concerns image classification rather than pixel-level segmentation.
A review of AI-based plant disease detection methods, applications, and limitations; secondary literature, not a primary benchmark.
A systematic literature review of challenges in applying machine learning to agricultural big data; secondary literature.
A bibliographic analysis/survey of deep learning in smart farming; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.

Tiny-YOLOv3 on a Jetson TX2 recognizes longan fruit-tree pests (bounding-box detection) in an orchard for pesticide spraying; pest bounding-box detection in the orchard/fruit domain, not crop/weed segmentation.

A lightweight semantic-segmentation network maps weeds onboard a UAV, achieving 80.9% accuracy and 4.5 FPS on a Jetson TX2 with FP16 quantization; a direct match for UAV DL weed segmentation and edge inference performance.
A comprehensive review of remote-sensing sensor systems for field crop monitoring; secondary literature.
A critical review of IoT-equipped, AI-enabled smart agriculture; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A survey of challenges and opportunities for autonomous micro-UAVs in precision agriculture; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
Faster R-CNN detects and counts oil palm trees in UAV imagery; bounding-box detection in a plantation/tree domain outside crop/weed pixel segmentation.

Mask R-CNN performs weed detection and segmentation in cotton using UAV-borne imagery (including synthetic-augmentation variants), reporting segmentation mask mAP and bounding-box mAP, satisfying UAV crop/weed segmentation with pixel-level metrics.
MST-DeepLabv3+ segments high-resolution remote-sensing land-cover (ISPRS/GID/cultivated-land) imagery, which is not UAV-imagery-based nor crop/weed pixel segmentation.
A review paper consolidating literature on image-based crop disease detection using machine learning; secondary literature, not a primary benchmark.
A review of CNN applications in smart agriculture using multimodal data; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A systematic literature review of AI technology in the agricultural sector; secondary literature.
An improved ENet real-time network segments farmland crop rows to extract navigation lines for UAV flight; a crop-row/navigation-line detection task rather than pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
